evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Joanna: 'it might take about ten to fifteen minutes if this is a good time.' Cameron: 'Yeah, that sounds good.' — Rep gives time frame but does not explicitly state promise of dependable quote or wait for a clear yes to the full frame.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Joanna: 'aside from the pricing, is there any other important concerns that you also want to discuss on this call?' Cameron: 'Nope.' — Asked before any probing started.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Rep asked: property type (one story), square footage (1265), bedrooms (3), specific furniture items (bed, nightstands, dresser, bookcase, desk, couch, TV, console), box count estimate (40-50, customer said less), parking (front/driveway at both locations). Covered all major logistics items.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Joanna: 'are you planning to like pack all of the boxes yourself, or do you need help with that as well?' Cameron: 'Nope, we'll pack them all ourselves.' — Asked explicitly.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Joanna: 'do you think you'll have that $40 to fifty boxes in total?' Cameron: 'Probably a little bit less than that.' — Asked.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Joanna: 'typically a house the size...usually that takes three and a half to five and a half hours to complete locally...estimating it more on the three and a half to four hour mark...about ten hours total to ten and a half hours...estimated budget of $3,659 including the transportation fee and the overnight fee already.' — Anchored to typical time range and personalized to customer's specific items and travel time.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Joanna disclosed: hourly rate ($104/hr per mover, $208 for two), transportation fee ($1,131), overnight fee ($240), 2.5-hour minimum, 15-minute increments, no hidden fees. Also mentioned no credit card fees, no disassembly/reassembly fees. Fee transparency and commitment framing both present.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Rep never asked 'Does that feel fair?' or equivalent. Moved directly to 'do you have any Ian so far?' — not asked.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Joanna: 'on time guarantee if we run late on the time that we schedule, we provide discounts for your move.' — Mentions discounts for lateness but does not specify the discount structure or terms (starts discounting immediately, % off, etc.). Partial credit.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Joanna: 'our no worries damage coverage. Which would give you up to $2,000 coverage for any accidental damages...repair, replacement. Reimbursement.' — Mentions $2,000 coverage and repair/replacement/reimbursement, but does NOT explicitly state 'no deductible' or 'no fine print' framing, and does not clearly state it's built into the rate (not an add-on). Partial credit.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: Rep does not ask a version of 'Does that put those to rest?' or confirm concerns are addressed. Rep pivots directly to 'do you have any Ian so far?' — False.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Joanna: 'Alright, so, yup, do you have any Ian so far? Go ahead.' — Appears to be a throwaway 'any questions' variant, not a genuine 'What's still concerning you about this move?' — throwaway.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Rep never asks 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' or equivalent. — False.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Rep offers to send email and customer says 'I should be able to let you know or book it in the next probably day or so.' Rep never asks plainly 'Would you like our help with your move?' — never.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Rep confirms date (October 8th, Thursday, with possible Friday contingency discussed), pickup address (13701 Ronald Reagan Boulevard, Cedar Park), drop-off address (1328 Humps Street, Flower), and that customer will respond to email. Does NOT confirm phone number, arrival window, or crew size. Partial credit.

top_strength: Joanna gathered comprehensive logistics details (furniture inventory, box count, parking, special considerations) and delivered a fully personalized estimate anchored to typical timelines with complete fee transparency upfront.
coaching_note: End the estimate discussion with 'Does that feel fair?' and hold the silence — do not pivot to 'any questions' — then deliver a genuine final concerns check before asking for the business plainly, without offering an email escape route.
